newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF says plans to auction 10-yr JGBs on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: MOF says plans to auction 10-yr JGBs on Tuesday.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) plans to offer 10-year Japanese government bonds (JGB) through a price-competitive auction on Tuesday, a MOF official said on Monday.
Traders said that judging from current market conditions, the MOF is likely to offer one trillion yen worth of 2.6 percent 10-year JGBs.
This will be the first auction since MOF announced last week that it was suspending scandal-tainted Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd from JGB auctions and underwriting "for the time being".
Nomura Securities Co Ltd has been suspended from JGB auctions and underwriting since May 15 due to a payoff scandal.
The previously issued 196th 10-year JGB carried a coupon rate of 2.7 percent.
